claim: Cooperative reconfiguration can preserve modular-swarm manipulation capability after joint failures without spare replacement modules.

provenance.source_title: Fault-tolerant modular robotic swarm through cooperative reconfiguration for large-scale on-orbit assembly
limitations: Modular robotic assembly scale is larger and mechanically different from a 10 mm SNS node.
Transfer to free-flying orbital swarms is not demonstrated.
Capability preservation depends on the declared module and failure model.
provenance.fact_summary: The authors present cooperative reconfiguration intended to preserve modular-swarm manipulation capability after joint failures without spare replacement modules.
provenance.inference_summary: SNS swarm models should represent local role substitution, topology change, and graded capability loss instead of binary node survival alone.
provenance.speculation_summary: Reconfiguration may be most applicable to larger relay, assembly, or service nodes within a heterogeneous SNS ecology.
